title: 1756 Uwchlan Meetinghouse

services.name: Meeting House Rental
services.desc: The 1756 Uwchlan Meeting House is available for meetings, weddings, family parties, memorial services and other functions for up to seventy-five people. The meeting house is conveniently located at 5 N. Village Avenue, in Lionville, just west of the intersection of Routes 100 and 113. (GPS-Exton, PA). Please support the Uwchlan Conservation Trust by making a charitable contribution
